intro.text: Hey there, rookie! I'm Dot. Thirty years running dispatch in this valley.
I'm retiring, so this little garage is yours now. One rusty hatchback, one driver, big dreams.
Out there are eight regions full of clients who need things moved. Quickly. Quietly. No questions.
Every border, every route, every risk... from now on, that's your call.
First things first: every empire needs a name.
{company}. I like it! Now let's earn your first dollar.

fleet.hint: Complete your first delivery to unlock the Fleet.

map.hint: Complete 3 deliveries to unlock the World Map.
